# CollegeVine

> > CollegeVine is an AI-powered platform for higher education that provides institutional AI agents for enrollment management and student services, plus college admissions guidance for high school students.

The platform serves 250+ universities with FERPA, SOC2 II, and TX-RAMP compliant AI solutions for campus automation, while also offering comprehensive resources for students navigating college applications, essays, financial aid, and extracurricular planning.

## Key Topics

- AI Agents for Higher Education
- Enrollment Management
- Student Services & Campus Automation
- FERPA & SOC2 II Compliance
- TX-RAMP Certification
- College Admissions Guidance
- College Applications & Essays
- FAFSA & Financial Aid
- Standardized Tests (SAT/ACT)
- Extracurricular Activities
- Summer Programs for High School Students
- Institutional AI Solutions
- High School College Counseling

## Platform & Product

- [CollegeVine](https://staging.collegevine.com/): AI platform for higher education with FERPA/SOC2 compliance at 250+ unis
